name: Death and Love
source:
“The characters are fine. Everything is in its place. There are no mistakes here.”

One more day, just like always.
Angels and demons coexist after a war that happened a thousand years ago.
You work in a quiet bar while spending the summer sharing an apartment with your roommate, like any other year.
What could possibly go wrong now, after so many years of peace?

Until you notice that something… isn’t like the original.
Something feels off.

You remember this wasn’t how things were.
But you’re not supposed to remember anything.

It doesn’t matter. Don’t think too much about it.
After all, this is just a story. And stories can’t be broken 

[From [url=https://ash-ashtroom.itch.io/death-and-love-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“角色很好。一切都在它的位置上。这里没有错误。”

又过了一天，就像往常一样。
一千年前发生的一场战争之后，天使与恶魔共存。
和往年一样，你在一家安静的酒吧工作，同时与你的室友合住一套公寓度过了整个夏天。
经过这么多年的和平，现在可能会出现什么问题呢？

直到你注意到有些东西……与原来的不一样。
感觉有些不对劲。

你记得事情不是这样的。
但你不应该记住任何事情。

没关系。不要想太多。
毕竟，这只是一个故事。故事无法被打破
